purpose: Leaf-level routing corpus. Each case names the observable signals a small root model can identify and the minimum credible tier/effort the skill must assign. routingctl.minimum_route is the deterministic reference; the corpus protects it against regressions in both directions: paying frontier tokens for cheap leaves and under-routing risky small leaves.
